rationale: The claim accurately reports the empirical findings of Guo et al. (2017) regarding miscalibration in modern neural networks and the effectiveness of temperature scaling. By explicitly restricting the scope to the paper's evaluated settings and stating that calibration is not a system-level safety bound, the claim successfully anticipates the challenge that calibration can fail under distribution shift and must not be treated as an unexplained safety score.
limitations: Calibration on a held-out distribution does not show calibrated uncertainty under operational distribution shift, correlated sensor faults, or closed-loop control effects.
